description.zh-Hans: 调查员说人话，NPC 戴语言面具：每个人一张很小的面具——自称与称呼、句末习惯、用词层次、一句口癖——再配三组「陌生人问一句、他答一句」的示例。书里印了台词的人照书说；书里没写的人，后台车道替他写一次。面具是守秘人每句都要戴上的，示例只作参考，从不照念。
description.en: The investigator speaks plainly; every NPC wears a small speech mask — what they call people, how their sentences end, the level of their words, one pet phrase — with three sample exchanges showing it in reply. A book that prints someone's speech keeps it; for the people a book left silent a background lane writes the mask once. The Keeper wears the mask on every line and never reads an exchange out.

actor_profile_keys.label: mask
actor_profile_keys.ask: one line, only when the book prints this person's speech: what they call themselves and the one they talk to, one sentence-ending habit, the level of their words, one pet phrase

actor_profile_keys.label: in exchange
actor_profile_keys.ask: up to three exchanges the book prints, each on one line: what someone says to this person, an arrow, what this person says back
